title: 欧洲央行换帅已定：德科斯接棒拉加德，荷兰为何最后才随共识？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Spanish economist Pablo Hernandez de Cast will become the next president of the European Central Bank.
segments.zh: 西班牙经济学家德科斯将成为欧洲央行下一任行长。

segments.en: Deal has been struck to replace Christine Lagarde, but the formal process is still underway.
segments.zh: 接替克里斯蒂娜·拉加德的协议已达成，但正式程序仍在进行中。

segments.en: Let's get the latest to know from Bloomberg economics editor Zoe Schneeva, who joins us from Frankfurt for more. Zoe, good to talk to you. Tell us then, where is the process at this moment
segments.zh: 我们连线彭博经济编辑佐伊·施内瓦，她从法兰克福带来最新消息。佐伊，你好。请告诉我们，目前程序进展到哪一步了？

segments.en: and how certain are we that it's Pablo Hernandez de Cast that's taking over?
segments.zh: 我们有多大把握是德科斯接任？

segments.en: So, first things first, we are 100% certain that it is Pablo Hernandez de Cast, there still are some formal issues here. The problem today was with European
segments.zh: 首先，我们百分之百确定是德科斯，但仍有一些正式问题。今天的问题出在欧洲

segments.en: EU leaders, our meeting in Brussels and the Dutch who also had filled their own candidate with class note had not been quite willing to concede. They were pushing for other concessions,
segments.zh: 欧盟领导人在布鲁塞尔开会，荷兰也提出了自己的候选人，但不太愿意让步。他们要求其他让步，

segments.en: they were generally a little bit annoyed, we know that the French and Germans basically decided that between themselves and the Dutch just wanted to have some kind of acknowledgement here.
segments.zh: 他们总体上有些不满，我们知道法国和德国基本上自行决定，而荷兰只是想要某种认可。

segments.en: In the end of the Dutch said, if this is the consensus opinion, this is what we are willing to go with the consensus. This again is all behind closed doors, so my colleagues here in Brussels
segments.zh: 最后荷兰表示，如果这是共识意见，我们愿意跟随共识。这同样是闭门进行的，所以我在布鲁塞尔的同事

segments.en: have been doing very good work speaking with those people, but we do know now that it will be the cost that there is no question about that. There was maybe a tiny bit of a question
segments.zh: 一直做得很好，与那些人交流，但我们现在知道将是德科斯，毫无疑问。也许曾有一点点疑问

segments.en: mark, couldn't the Dutch protests here ensure that maybe something isn't decided today.
segments.zh: 荷兰的抗议是否可能导致今天无法决定某些事情。
